name: The Statement of Randolph Carter
source:
The Statement Of Randolph Carter is an adaptation of H.P Lovecraft's short story of the same name. This is my labor of love project to honor his work, and hopefully to bring it's story to more people.

Take the role of Randolph Carter, and journey alongside Harley Warren through Big Cypress Swamp. The two of you are on a mission to discover and ancient, untold secret, one that Warren is most eager to learn. Descending deeper into a long-forgotten crypt, Harley and Carter slip into madness and the horrors beneath.

[from [url=https://lunarismystigma.itch.io/the-statement-of-randolph-carter]Itch.io[/url]]
